annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/481 of 3 March 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 as regards type-approval of the automated driving system of fully automated vehicles
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/481 of 3 March 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 as regards type-approval of the automated driving system of fully automated vehicles
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation amending 2022/1426 to lift the small-series cap for automated valet parking vehicles. It adds Annex V with technical specifications (30 km/h limit, collision avoidance, minimal-risk condition, manufacturer responsibility) and test scenarios for type-approval of AVP automated driving system features.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends type-approval of fully automated vehicles to AVP use case beyond the 1,500 small-series limit
AVP speed capped at 30 km/h and must avoid collisions with road users and obstacles
Manufacturer remains solely responsible for compliance regardless of third parties
Annex V sets test scenarios: obstacles, sensor occlusion, wireless and infrastructure failure, override
Dual-mode vehicles must comply with UN Regulations 79 and 13/13-H
